name: sms
description: School Management System — npm workspaces monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @sms/shared" "npm run dev -w @sms/server" "npm run dev -w @sms/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sms/shared && npm run build -w @sms/server && npm run build -w @sms/client
